requirement: The web server segment 10.0.2.0/24 must be able to reach the client segment 10.0.1.0/24 through the transit link; add the necessary return route on r2.

proposal.rationale: The requirement is clear and actionable. It involves adding a static route on router r2 to allow traffic from the web server segment (10.0.2.0/24) to reach the client segment (10.0.1.0/24) through the transit link.
